question: What name is given to this formulation as the supreme śāṅkarī root vidyā?
premises: It is named as the supreme śāṅkarī root vidyā.
inference: This is declared to be the supreme śāṅkarī root vidyā.
uncertainties: The internal structure of mūlavidyānuttaraśāṅkarī allows more than one compound analysis.
plain_english: This indeed is declared to be the supreme śāṅkarī root vidyā.
